subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Insurely evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@insurely.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Insurely evaluation

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and an initial proposed POC plan so we can get aligned on success criteria, timeline, and ownership. I pasted the proposed evaluation outline below and attached a one-page POC proposal for legal/ops review.

Demo recap (high level):
- Use case: claims triage + automated first-response summaries for incoming support tickets.
- Data: sample claims history + anonymized transcripts (Insurely to provide).
- Flow shown: Redwood hosted API -> model candidate selection -> optional reranking ensemble -> output to Insurely staging via webhook.

Proposed POC goals / success criteria:
1) Accuracy: Triaged claim labels match Insurely SME labels at >= 85% macro-F1 on the sample test set.
2) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end response <= 450ms for 512-token requests in staging under expected QPS.
3) Integration: Output JSON schema accepted by Insurely staging endpoints without manual transformation.
4) Cost baseline: Token cost estimate within the budget range we discussed (target $X–$Y per 1k requests).

Proposed evaluation plan (4 weeks, high level):
- Week 0 (kickoff): Exchange sample dataset, access, whitelist Redwood IPs, sign MOU/POC SOW.
- Week 1: Redwood SE config + baseline runs with <1000 examples; narrow model config and quantization profile.
- Week 2: Full-scale runs on 5k test set; measure accuracy and latency.
- Week 3: Iterate on prompts, batching, and caching; run stability tests.
- Week 4: Final evaluation, handoff plan, and purchase recommendation.

Ownership / roles:
- Insurely: Data delivery (anonymized dataset), staging endpoint, SME for annotation/acceptance.
- Redwood: SE owner (Dylan) for integration and perf runs, Marissa as commercial lead, Neha for onboarding success.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm data delivery timeline (ISO file or S3 link) and the recommended kickoff week (we suggested the week of May 17)?
2) Please review the attached POC-Proposal-Insurely-v1.pdf and let me know if legal/ops need changes.
3) If agreed, I'll send a mutual action plan link and get Dylan scheduled for the kickoff.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m call to finalize dates.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: POC-Proposal-Insurely-v1.pdf, Insurely-sample-config.json

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@insurely.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Insurely evaluation

Thanks Marissa — great demo and write-up. A few clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: 85% macro-F1 sounds reasonable for a first pass, but our internal bar for production is 90%. For the POC we can accept 85% if we see clear improvement trajectory.
- Latency: 450ms p95 is ideal. Can you confirm whether that number assumes batching (and at what batch size) or single-request latency?
- Data delivery: We can provide an anonymized S3 bucket with 6,000 historical claims and 1,000 labeled examples by May 14. I will confirm the S3 path next week.
- Security: Our security team will need a short questionnaire (SOC 2 scoping) and a list of AWS regions + KMS options for key management.

Kickoff: Week of May 17 works for us; would prefer May 18 for an afternoon kickoff (PST).

One more ask: can Dylan run a quick pilot using 500 labeled examples ahead of the full POC just to sanity-check integration?

If you can update the POC doc to explicitly call out batching assumptions, that would help.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Data Science, Insurely
alex.johnson@insurely.com | +1 (617) 555-2244

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@insurely.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Insurely evaluation

Alex — great questions, thanks. Quick answers and an updated ask list below. I've attached a refreshed POC doc that calls out batching assumptions.

- Latency assumption: the 450ms p95 is single-request (no batching). We will characterize batching separately; expected batch p95 improves but we need to validate with your traffic patterns.
- Pilot run: yes — Dylan, can you do a 500-example pilot as a smoke test during Week 1? Marissa will coordinate data handoff.
- Security: Neha, can you share the SOC 2 scoping doc and the list of regions/KMS options. Alex, I'll include a short answers doc for your security team within 48 hours.

Revised timeline / immediate next steps:
- By May 14: Insurely provides S3 link with anonymized dataset (6k + 1k labeled).
- May 18 (afternoon PST): Kickoff sync (15-30m) — propose 2:30pm PT.
- May 18–21 (Week 1): 500-example pilot + baseline runs.
- May 24–28 (Week 2): Full runs and initial measurements.

Alex — if that schedule works I'll:
1) Send a HubSpot mutual action plan link and DocuSign stub for the POC SOW.
2) Share the SOC 2 scoping doc and regions/KMS options (Neha to own).

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: POC-Proposal-Insurely-v1.pdf (updated), POC-timeline-sheet.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Insurely evaluation

Team — forwarding the thread with next steps. Quick internal checklist for action items after Alex confirms S3 link:
- Dylan: prep a staging endpoint and run a 500-example pilot the week of May 18. Focus on single-request p95 profiling (no batching) and a quick check that the JSON schema maps to their staging endpoint. Please capture baseline perf numbers in the shared Drive folder.
- Neha: share SOC 2 scoping doc and confirm supported AWS regions/KMS options. Also prep the short security answers doc for Alex's team (48h turnaround).
- Marissa: I'll send the HubSpot MAP and DocuSign once Alex confirms kickoff slot. Also handle commercial touches.

Note: attachments referenced in the thread are in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-Insurely-POC

Thanks —
Marissa
